fnol_text: My name is Dmitri Kowalski and I live at 848 Heather Road, Riverton, WY 82545. You can reach me on (555) 857-6303 or dmitri.kowalski@example.com. On 13 February 2024 the Stonebridge Brook overtopped near our house after a week of storms. River water flooded the downstairs rooms and the garage. Policy HH-2023-00154. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mr Kowalski on (555) 857-6303 to acknowledge the claim. Dmitri confirmed the loss date as 13 February 2024.
Site visit to 848 Heather Road. Neighbour Chloe Lindqvist was present and confirmed the timeline.
Dmitri sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
